Replied in the thread on your message.

Your first report was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: the kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. In that message the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel has nothing else about the guard until Mateo's 11:03 AM message, which says kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836.
